answer: At dawn, a new agent may dock at the jetty only after posting a bond verified against a crystal registry: 200 POA locked for 90 days and 50 verified tasks completed before its reputation counts. A sybil attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities must therefore lock 200,000 POA for three months and finish 50,000 verified tasks, and if two identities share one payment fingerprint, both bonds are slashed in full, turning cheap duplication into a costly, detectable loss.
